create_llm_engine: create an LLM engine with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M model and 1M max context length
run_generate_texts: run text generation on a 600k-token prompt using vLLM with sampling parameters
load_prompt_remote: load a 600k-token test prompt from a remote URL for offline inference
build_sampling_params: build a SamplingParams object with temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, and max 256 tokens
process_requests_generate: process batched prompts through the LLM engine and print generated text with prompt length
